```java
	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3");
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
					cells[r][c] = new Wall(new Coordinate(r, c));
				} else {
					cells[r][c] = new FillableCell(new Coordinate(r, c));
				}
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceInfo.coord;
		Direction sourceDir = sourceInfo.dir;
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceCoord, sourceDir, TerminationCell.Type.SOURCE);
		cells[sourceCoord.row][sourceCoord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		Coordinate sinkCoord = sinkInfo.coord;
		Direction sinkDir = sinkInfo.dir;
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkCoord, sinkDir, TerminationCell.Type.SINK);
		cells[sinkCoord.row][sinkCoord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3");
		}
		if (cells == null || cells.length != rows) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array row count mismatch");
		}
		for (Cell[] row : cells) {
			if (row == null || row.length != cols) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array column count mismatch");
			}
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		TerminationCell foundSource = null;
		TerminationCell foundSink = null;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = cells[r][c];
				if (cell == null) {
					throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at (" + r + "," + c + ") is null");
				}
				this.cells[r][c] = cell;
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell tc) {
					Coordinate coord = tc.coord;
					Direction dir = tc.pointingTo;
					boolean isEdge = (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1);
					if (tc.type == TerminationCell.Type.SOURCE) {
						if (isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Source cell must not be on edge at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
						}
						if (foundSource != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple source cells found");
						}
						Coordinate adjacent = coord.add(dir.getOffset());
						if (!isWithinBounds(adjacent)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Source cell points outside the map at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
						}
						Cell adjacentCell = cells[adjacent.row][adjacent.col];
						if (adjacentCell instanceof Wall) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Source cell points into a wall at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
						}
						foundSource = tc;
					} else if (tc.type == TerminationCell.Type.SINK) {
						if (!isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink cell must be on edge at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
						}
						if (foundSink != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple sink cells found");
						}
						Coordinate adjacent = coord.add(dir.getOffset());
						if (isWithinBounds(adjacent)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Sink cell must point outside the map at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
						}
						foundSink = tc;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (foundSource == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No source cell found");
		}
		if (foundSink == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No sink cell found");
		}
		this.sourceCell = foundSource;
		this.sinkCell = foundSink;
	}

	boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
		int zeroBasedRow = row - 1;
		int zeroBasedCol = col - 1;
		if (zeroBasedRow < 0 || zeroBasedRow >= rows || zeroBasedCol < 0 || zeroBasedCol >= cols) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell cell = cells[zeroBasedRow][zeroBasedCol];
		if (cell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
			if (fillableCell.getPipe() == null) {
				fillableCell.setPipe(p);
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}
}
```

```java
package game.pipes;

import game.MapElement;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Direction;
import util.PipePatterns;

public class Pipe implements MapElement {

    @NotNull
    private final Shape shape;
    private boolean filled = false;

    /**
     * Creates a new pipe with a given shape.
     *
     * @param shape Shape of the pipe.
     */
    public Pipe(@NotNull Shape shape) {
        this.shape = shape;
    }

    /**
     * Sets the pipe as filled.
     */
    public void setFilled() {
        filled = true;
    }

    /**
     * @return Whether this pipe is filled.
     */
    public boolean getFilled() {
        return filled;
    }

    /**
     * @return List of connections for this pipe.
     * @throws IllegalStateException if {@code this} pipe cannot be identified.
     */
    public @NotNull Direction[] getConnections() {
        switch (shape) {
            case HORIZONTAL:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.LEFT, Direction.RIGHT};
            case VERTICAL:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.UP, Direction.DOWN};
            case TOP_LEFT:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.UP, Direction.LEFT};
            case TOP_RIGHT:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.UP, Direction.RIGHT};
            case BOTTOM_LEFT:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.DOWN, Direction.LEFT};
            case BOTTOM_RIGHT:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.DOWN, Direction.RIGHT};
            case CROSS:
                return Direction.values();
            default:
                throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown shape");
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return The character representation of this pipe. Note that the representation is different for filled and
     * unfilled pipes.
     */
    @Override
    public char toSingleChar() {
        return shape.getCharByState(filled);
    }

    /**
     * Converts a String to a Pipe.
     *
     * <p>
     * Here is the list of ASCII representation to the pipes:
     * TL: Top-Left
     * TR: Top-Right
     * BL: Bottom-Left
     * BR: Bottom-Right
     * HZ: Horizontal
     * VT: Vertical
     * CR: Cross
     * </p>
     *
     * @param rep String representation of the pipe.
     * @return Pipe identified by the string.
     * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the String does not represent a known pipe.
     */
    public static @NotNull Pipe fromString(@NotNull String rep) {
        String actualRep = rep.trim();

        Pipe.Shape shape;
        switch (actualRep) {
            case "HZ":
                shape = Shape.HORIZONTAL;
                break;
            case "VT":
                shape = Shape.VERTICAL;
                break;
            case "TL":
                shape = Shape.TOP_LEFT;
                break;
            case "TR":
                shape = Shape.TOP_RIGHT;
                break;
            case "BL":
                shape = Shape.BOTTOM_LEFT;
                break;
            case "BR":
                shape = Shape.BOTTOM_RIGHT;
                break;
            case "CR":
                shape = Shape.CROSS;
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown shape");
        }

        return new Pipe(shape);
    }

    public enum Shape {
        HORIZONTAL(PipePatterns.Filled.HORIZONTAL, PipePatterns.Unfilled.HORIZONTAL),
        VERTICAL(PipePatterns.Filled.VERTICAL, PipePatterns.Unfilled.VERTICAL),
        TOP_LEFT(PipePatterns.Filled.TOP_LEFT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.TOP_LEFT),
        TOP_RIGHT(PipePatterns.Filled.TOP_RIGHT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.TOP_RIGHT),
        BOTTOM_LEFT(PipePatterns.Filled.BOTTOM_LEFT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.BOTTOM_LEFT),
        BOTTOM_RIGHT(PipePatterns.Filled.BOTTOM_RIGHT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.BOTTOM_RIGHT),
        CROSS(PipePatterns.Filled.CROSS, PipePatterns.Unfilled.CROSS);

        final char filledChar;
        final char unfilledChar;

        Shape(char filled, char unfilled) {
            this.filledChar = filled;
            this.unfilledChar = unfilled;
        }

        char getCharByState(boolean isFilled) {
            return isFilled ? filledChar : unfilledChar;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;

/**
 * Represents a direction in reference to a {@link game.map.cells.Cell}.
 */
public enum Direction {
    UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT;

    /**
     * @return The opposite direction of {@code this}.
     */
    @NotNull
    public Direction getOpposite() {
        switch (this) {
            case UP:
                return DOWN;
            case DOWN:
                return UP;
            case LEFT:
                return RIGHT;
            case RIGHT:
                return LEFT;
            default:
                throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown direction");
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return A unit coordinate offset as expressed by {@code this} coordinate.
     */
    @NotNull
    public Coordinate getOffset() {
        switch (this) {
            case UP:
                return new Coordinate(-1, 0);
            case DOWN:
                return new Coordinate(1, 0);
            case LEFT:
                return new Coordinate(0, -1);
            case RIGHT:
                return new Coordinate(0, 1);
            default:
                throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown direction");
        }
    }
```

```java
package game.map.cells;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Coordinate;
import util.Direction;
import util.PipePatterns;

/**
 * Represents a source or a sink {@link Cell}.
 */
public class TerminationCell extends Cell {

    private boolean isFilled = false;
    @NotNull
    public final Direction pointingTo;
    @NotNull
    public final Type type;

    public TerminationCell(Coordinate coord, @NotNull Direction d, @NotNull Type type) {
        super(coord);
        this.pointingTo = d;
        this.type = type;
    }

    /**
     * Sets this cell as filled.
     */
    public void setFilled() {
        isFilled = true;
    }

    @Override
    public char toSingleChar() {
        if (isFilled) {
            switch (pointingTo) {
                case UP:
                    return PipePatterns.Filled.UP_ARROW;
                case DOWN:
                    return PipePatterns.Filled.DOWN_ARROW;
                case LEFT:
                    return PipePatterns.Filled.LEFT_ARROW;
                case RIGHT:
                    return PipePatterns.Filled.RIGHT_ARROW;
            }
        } else {
            switch (pointingTo) {
                case UP:
                    return PipePatterns.Unfilled.UP_ARROW;
                case DOWN:
                    return PipePatterns.Unfilled.DOWN_ARROW;
                case LEFT:
                    return PipePatterns.Unfilled.LEFT_ARROW;
                case RIGHT:
                    return PipePatterns.Unfilled.RIGHT_ARROW;
            }
        }

        throw new IllegalStateException("Invalid pointingTo value!");
    }

    public enum Type {
        SOURCE, SINK
    }

    /**
     * Data class encapsulating the coordinate and direction of the {@link TerminationCell}.
     */
    public static class CreateInfo {

        public final Coordinate coord;
        public final Direction dir;

        public CreateInfo(@NotNull Coordinate coord, @NotNull Direction dir) {
            this.coord = coord;
            this.dir = dir;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package util;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Representation of a coordinate in {@link game.map.Map}.
 */
public class Coordinate {

    public final int row;
    public final int col;

    public Coordinate(int row, int col) {
        this.row = row;
        this.col = col;
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritDoc}
     */
    @Override
    public boolean equals(@Nullable Object obj) {
        if (obj == null) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!(obj instanceof Coordinate)) {
            return false;
        }

        return equals((Coordinate) obj);
    }

    public boolean equals(@NotNull Coordinate other) {
        return this.row == other.row && this.col == other.col;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hash(row, col);
    }

    /**
     * Adds {@code this} coordinate with another coordinate.
     *
     * @param other Other coordinate to add from.
     * @return New coordinate as a result of the addition.
     */
    @NotNull public Coordinate add(@NotNull Coordinate other) {
        return new Coordinate(this.row + other.row, this.col + other.col);
    }
}
```

```java
package game.map.cells;

import game.MapElement;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;
import util.Direction;

/**
 * Representation of a cell in the {@link game.map.Map}.
 */
public abstract class Cell implements MapElement {

    @NotNull
    public final Coordinate coord;

    Cell(@NotNull Coordinate coord) {
        this.coord = coord;
    }

    /**
     * Parses a {@link Cell} from a character.
     *
     * <p>
     * Here is the list of characters to their corresponding map element:
     * W: Wall
     * .: Cell
     * ^: Source/Sink pipe pointing upward
     * v: Source/Sink pipe pointing downward
     * <: Source/Sink pipe pointing leftward
     * >: Source/Sink pipe pointing rightward
     * If the character does not represent a {@link TerminationCell}, the {@code terminationType} parameter can be ignored.
     * </p>
     *
     * @param c Character to parse.
     * @param coord Coordinate of the newly created cell.
     * @param terminationType If the character is a termination cell, its type. Otherwise, this argument is ignored and
     *                        can be null.
     * @return A cell based on the given creation parameters, or null if the parameters cannot form a valid Cell.
     */
    public static @Nullable Cell fromChar(char c, @NotNull Coordinate coord, @Nullable TerminationCell.Type terminationType) {
        switch (c) {
            case 'W':
                return new Wall(coord);
            case '.':
                return new FillableCell(coord);
            case '^':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.UP, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case '>':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.RIGHT, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case '<':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.LEFT, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case 'v':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.DOWN, terminationType);
                }
                break;
        }

        return null;
    }
}
```

Response Text:---
The `fillTiles(int distance)` method should fill all pipes (cells containing pipes) that are within the given Manhattan distance from the `sourceCell`. The filling should propagate through connected pipes respecting their connections and directions.

A good approach is to use a breadth-first search (BFS) starting from the `sourceCell` coordinate, expanding outwards step by step, and filling pipes up to the given distance. We keep track of visited coordinates to avoid revisiting and infinite loops.

Here is a complete implementation of the `fillTiles` method for the `Map` class:

```java
public void fillTiles(int distance) {
    if (distance < 0 || sourceCell == null) {
        return;
    }

    // Clear previous filled tiles and reset filled state on pipes
    for (Coordinate coord : filledTiles) {
        Cell cell = cells[coord.row][coord.col];
        if (cell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
            Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
            if (pipe != null) {
                pipe.setFilled(); // reset filled to false is not possible here, so we rely on fresh fill
            }
        } else if (cell instanceof TerminationCell terminationCell) {
            terminationCell.setFilled(); // reset filled to false is not possible here, so we rely on fresh fill
        }
    }
    filledTiles.clear();

    // BFS queue: each element is a pair of coordinate and current distance from source
    Queue<Map.Entry<Coordinate, Integer>> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
    Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceCell.coord;

    // Mark source cell as filled and add to queue
    sourceCell.setFilled();
    filledTiles.add(sourceCoord);
    queue.offer(Map.entry(sourceCoord, 0));

    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Map.Entry<Coordinate, Integer> entry = queue.poll();
        Coordinate current = entry.getKey();
        int currentDistance = entry.getValue();

        if (currentDistance >= distance) {
            continue; // reached max distance
        }

        Cell currentCell = cells[current.row][current.col];

        // Get possible directions to move from current cell
        Direction[] connections;

        if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell terminationCell) {
            // TerminationCell connects only in the direction it points to and opposite
            connections = new Direction[]{terminationCell.pointingTo.getOpposite(), terminationCell.pointingTo};
        } else if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
            Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
            if (pipe == null) {
                continue; // no pipe to fill or traverse
            }
            connections = pipe.getConnections();
        } else {
            // Wall or other cell types cannot be traversed
            continue;
        }

        // Mark current cell as filled
        if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
            Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
            if (pipe != null && !pipe.getFilled()) {
                pipe.setFilled();
                filledTiles.add(current);
            }
        } else if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell terminationCell) {
            terminationCell.setFilled();
            filledTiles.add(current);
        }

        // Explore neighbors connected by pipes
        for (Direction dir : connections) {
            Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(dir.getOffset());

            if (!isWithinBounds(neighborCoord)) {
                continue;
            }

            if (filledTiles.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                continue; // already filled
            }

            Cell neighborCell = cells[neighborCoord.row][neighborCoord.col];

            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell neighborFillable) {
                Pipe neighborPipe = neighborFillable.getPipe();
                if (neighborPipe == null) {
                    continue; // no pipe to traverse
                }

                // Check if neighbor pipe connects back to current cell
                Direction oppositeDir = dir.getOpposite();
                Direction[] neighborConnections = neighborPipe.getConnections();
                boolean connectsBack = false;
                for (Direction ndir : neighborConnections) {
                    if (ndir == oppositeDir) {
                        connectsBack = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!connectsBack) {
                    continue; // no connection back, so no flow
                }

                // Add neighbor to queue
                queue.offer(Map.entry(neighborCoord, currentDistance + 1));
            } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell neighborTerm) {
                // Check if neighbor termination cell connects back to current cell
                Direction oppositeDir = dir.getOpposite();
                if (neighborTerm.pointingTo == oppositeDir) {
                    // Add neighbor termination cell to queue
                    queue.offer(Map.entry(neighborCoord, currentDistance + 1));
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### Explanation:
- We use BFS starting from the `sourceCell`.
- At each step, we fill the current cell if it contains a pipe or is a termination cell.
- We then check all connected neighbors by verifying pipe connections in both directions.
- We only proceed if the neighbor pipe connects back to the current cell (ensuring valid pipe connection).
- We stop expanding once the distance limit is reached.
- We keep track of filled tiles in `filledTiles` set.

This method respects the hint and ensures all pipes within the given distance from the source are filled correctly.

```java
public class Map {

	 * @param rows     Number of rows.

	 * @return A map with the cells set from {@code cellsRep}.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the map is incorrectly formatted.
	 */
	@NotNull

		var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

		return new Map(rows, cols, cells);
	}

	/**

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	/**
	 * Displays the current map.

	public void display() {
		final int padLength = Integer.valueOf(rows - 1).toString().length();

		Runnable printColumns = () -> {
			System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			System.out.print(' ');
			for (int i = 0; i < cols - 2; ++i) {
				System.out.print((char) ('A' + i));
			}
			System.out.println();
		};

		printColumns.run();

		for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(String.format("%1$" + padLength + "s", i));
			} else {
				System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			}

			Arrays.stream(cells[i]).forEachOrdered(elem -> System.out.print(elem.toSingleChar()));

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(i);
			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3");
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
					cells[r][c] = new Wall(new Coordinate(r, c));
				} else {
					cells[r][c] = new FillableCell(new Coordinate(r, c));
				}
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceInfo.coord;
		Direction sourceDir = sourceInfo.dir;
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceCoord, sourceDir, TerminationCell.Type.SOURCE);
		cells[sourceCoord.row][sourceCoord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		Coordinate sinkCoord = sinkInfo.coord;
		Direction sinkDir = sinkInfo.dir;
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkCoord, sinkDir, TerminationCell.Type.SINK);
		cells[sinkCoord.row][sinkCoord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3");
		}
		if (cells == null || cells.length != rows) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array row count mismatch");
		}
		for (Cell[] row : cells) {
			if (row == null || row.length != cols) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array column count mismatch");
			}
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		TerminationCell foundSource = null;
		TerminationCell foundSink = null;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = cells[r][c];
				if (cell == null) {
					throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at (" + r + "," + c + ") is null");
				}
				this.cells[r][c] = cell;
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell tc) {
					Coordinate coord = tc.coord;
					Direction dir = tc.pointingTo;
					boolean isEdge = (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1);
					if (tc.type == TerminationCell.Type.SOURCE) {
						if (isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Source cell must not be on edge at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
						}
						if (foundSource != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple source cells found");
						}
						Coordinate adjacent = coord.add(dir.getOffset());
						if (!isWithinBounds(adjacent)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Source cell points outside the map at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
						}
						Cell adjacentCell = cells[adjacent.row][adjacent.col];
						if (adjacentCell instanceof Wall) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Source cell points into a wall at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
						}
						foundSource = tc;
					} else if (tc.type == TerminationCell.Type.SINK) {
						if (!isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink cell must be on edge at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
						}
						if (foundSink != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple sink cells found");
						}
						Coordinate adjacent = coord.add(dir.getOffset());
						if (isWithinBounds(adjacent)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Sink cell must point outside the map at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
						}
						foundSink = tc;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (foundSource == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No source cell found");
		}
		if (foundSink == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No sink cell found");
		}
		this.sourceCell = foundSource;
		this.sinkCell = foundSink;
	}

	boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
		int zeroBasedRow = row - 1;
		int zeroBasedCol = col - 1;
		if (zeroBasedRow < 0 || zeroBasedRow >= rows || zeroBasedCol < 0 || zeroBasedCol >= cols) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell cell = cells[zeroBasedRow][zeroBasedCol];
		if (cell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
			if (fillableCell.getPipe() == null) {
				fillableCell.setPipe(p);
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	/**
	 * Undoes a step from the map. <p> Effectively replaces the cell with an empty cell in the coordinate specified. </p>
	 * @param coord  Coordinate to reset.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException  if the cell is not an instance of  {@link FillableCell} .
	 */
	public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {
		if (!isWithinBounds(coord)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Coordinate out of map bounds: " + coord);
		}
		Cell cell = cells[coord.row][coord.col];
		if (!(cell instanceof FillableCell)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at " + coord + " is not a FillableCell");
		}
		cells[coord.row][coord.col] = new FillableCell(coord);
	}
}
```

```java
package game.pipes;

import game.MapElement;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Direction;
import util.PipePatterns;

public class Pipe implements MapElement {

    @NotNull
    private final Shape shape;
    private boolean filled = false;

    /**
     * Creates a new pipe with a given shape.
     *
     * @param shape Shape of the pipe.
     */
    public Pipe(@NotNull Shape shape) {
        this.shape = shape;
    }

    /**
     * Sets the pipe as filled.
     */
    public void setFilled() {
        filled = true;
    }

    /**
     * @return Whether this pipe is filled.
     */
    public boolean getFilled() {
        return filled;
    }

    /**
     * @return List of connections for this pipe.
     * @throws IllegalStateException if {@code this} pipe cannot be identified.
     */
    public @NotNull Direction[] getConnections() {
        switch (shape) {
            case HORIZONTAL:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.LEFT, Direction.RIGHT};
            case VERTICAL:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.UP, Direction.DOWN};
            case TOP_LEFT:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.UP, Direction.LEFT};
            case TOP_RIGHT:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.UP, Direction.RIGHT};
            case BOTTOM_LEFT:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.DOWN, Direction.LEFT};
            case BOTTOM_RIGHT:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.DOWN, Direction.RIGHT};
            case CROSS:
                return Direction.values();
            default:
                throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown shape");
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return The character representation of this pipe. Note that the representation is different for filled and
     * unfilled pipes.
     */
    @Override
    public char toSingleChar() {
        return shape.getCharByState(filled);
    }

    /**
     * Converts a String to a Pipe.
     *
     * <p>
     * Here is the list of ASCII representation to the pipes:
     * TL: Top-Left
     * TR: Top-Right
     * BL: Bottom-Left
     * BR: Bottom-Right
     * HZ: Horizontal
     * VT: Vertical
     * CR: Cross
     * </p>
     *
     * @param rep String representation of the pipe.
     * @return Pipe identified by the string.
     * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the String does not represent a known pipe.
     */
    public static @NotNull Pipe fromString(@NotNull String rep) {
        String actualRep = rep.trim();

        Pipe.Shape shape;
        switch (actualRep) {
            case "HZ":
                shape = Shape.HORIZONTAL;
                break;
            case "VT":
                shape = Shape.VERTICAL;
                break;
            case "TL":
                shape = Shape.TOP_LEFT;
                break;
            case "TR":
                shape = Shape.TOP_RIGHT;
                break;
            case "BL":
                shape = Shape.BOTTOM_LEFT;
                break;
            case "BR":
                shape = Shape.BOTTOM_RIGHT;
                break;
            case "CR":
                shape = Shape.CROSS;
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown shape");
        }

        return new Pipe(shape);
    }

    public enum Shape {
        HORIZONTAL(PipePatterns.Filled.HORIZONTAL, PipePatterns.Unfilled.HORIZONTAL),
        VERTICAL(PipePatterns.Filled.VERTICAL, PipePatterns.Unfilled.VERTICAL),
        TOP_LEFT(PipePatterns.Filled.TOP_LEFT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.TOP_LEFT),
        TOP_RIGHT(PipePatterns.Filled.TOP_RIGHT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.TOP_RIGHT),
        BOTTOM_LEFT(PipePatterns.Filled.BOTTOM_LEFT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.BOTTOM_LEFT),
        BOTTOM_RIGHT(PipePatterns.Filled.BOTTOM_RIGHT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.BOTTOM_RIGHT),
        CROSS(PipePatterns.Filled.CROSS, PipePatterns.Unfilled.CROSS);

        final char filledChar;
        final char unfilledChar;

        Shape(char filled, char unfilled) {
            this.filledChar = filled;
            this.unfilledChar = unfilled;
        }

        char getCharByState(boolean isFilled) {
            return isFilled ? filledChar : unfilledChar;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
/**
 * Represents a direction in reference to a {@link game.map.cells.Cell}.

public enum Direction {
    UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT;

    /**
     * @return The opposite direction of {@code this}.
     */
    @NotNull
    public Direction getOpposite() {
        switch (this) {
            case UP:
                return DOWN;
            case DOWN:
                return UP;
            case LEFT:
                return RIGHT;
            case RIGHT:
                return LEFT;
            default:
                throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown direction");
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return A unit coordinate offset as expressed by {@code this} coordinate.
     */
    @NotNull
    public Coordinate getOffset() {
        switch (this) {
            case UP:
                return new Coordinate(-1, 0);
            case DOWN:
                return new Coordinate(1, 0);
            case LEFT:
                return new Coordinate(0, -1);
            case RIGHT:
                return new Coordinate(0, 1);
            default:
                throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown direction");
        }
    }
```

```java
package game.map.cells;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Coordinate;
import util.Direction;
import util.PipePatterns;

/**
 * Represents a source or a sink {@link Cell}.
 */
public class TerminationCell extends Cell {

    private boolean isFilled = false;
    @NotNull
    public final Direction pointingTo;
    @NotNull
    public final Type type;

    public TerminationCell(Coordinate coord, @NotNull Direction d, @NotNull Type type) {
        super(coord);
        this.pointingTo = d;
        this.type = type;
    }

    /**
     * Sets this cell as filled.
     */
    public void setFilled() {
        isFilled = true;
    }

    @Override
    public char toSingleChar() {
        if (isFilled) {
            switch (pointingTo) {
                case UP:
                    return PipePatterns.Filled.UP_ARROW;
                case DOWN:
                    return PipePatterns.Filled.DOWN_ARROW;
                case LEFT:
                    return PipePatterns.Filled.LEFT_ARROW;
                case RIGHT:
                    return PipePatterns.Filled.RIGHT_ARROW;
            }
        } else {
            switch (pointingTo) {
                case UP:
                    return PipePatterns.Unfilled.UP_ARROW;
                case DOWN:
                    return PipePatterns.Unfilled.DOWN_ARROW;
                case LEFT:
                    return PipePatterns.Unfilled.LEFT_ARROW;
                case RIGHT:
                    return PipePatterns.Unfilled.RIGHT_ARROW;
            }
        }

        throw new IllegalStateException("Invalid pointingTo value!");
    }

    public enum Type {
        SOURCE, SINK
    }

    /**
     * Data class encapsulating the coordinate and direction of the {@link TerminationCell}.
     */
    public static class CreateInfo {

        public final Coordinate coord;
        public final Direction dir;

        public CreateInfo(@NotNull Coordinate coord, @NotNull Direction dir) {
            this.coord = coord;
            this.dir = dir;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package util;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;

import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Representation of a coordinate in {@link game.map.Map}.
 */
public class Coordinate {

    public final int row;
    public final int col;

    public Coordinate(int row, int col) {
        this.row = row;
        this.col = col;
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritDoc}
     */
    @Override
    public boolean equals(@Nullable Object obj) {
        if (obj == null) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!(obj instanceof Coordinate)) {
            return false;
        }

        return equals((Coordinate) obj);
    }

    public boolean equals(@NotNull Coordinate other) {
        return this.row == other.row && this.col == other.col;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hash(row, col);
    }

    /**
     * Adds {@code this} coordinate with another coordinate.
     *
     * @param other Other coordinate to add from.
     * @return New coordinate as a result of the addition.
     */
    @NotNull public Coordinate add(@NotNull Coordinate other) {
        return new Coordinate(this.row + other.row, this.col + other.col);
    }
}
```

```java
package game.map.cells;

import game.MapElement;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;
import util.Direction;

/**
 * Representation of a cell in the {@link game.map.Map}.
 */
public abstract class Cell implements MapElement {

    @NotNull
    public final Coordinate coord;

    Cell(@NotNull Coordinate coord) {
        this.coord = coord;
    }

    /**
     * Parses a {@link Cell} from a character.
     *
     * <p>
     * Here is the list of characters to their corresponding map element:
     * W: Wall
     * .: Cell
     * ^: Source/Sink pipe pointing upward
     * v: Source/Sink pipe pointing downward
     * <: Source/Sink pipe pointing leftward
     * >: Source/Sink pipe pointing rightward
     * If the character does not represent a {@link TerminationCell}, the {@code terminationType} parameter can be ignored.
     * </p>
     *
     * @param c Character to parse.
     * @param coord Coordinate of the newly created cell.
     * @param terminationType If the character is a termination cell, its type. Otherwise, this argument is ignored and
     *                        can be null.
     * @return A cell based on the given creation parameters, or null if the parameters cannot form a valid Cell.
     */
    public static @Nullable Cell fromChar(char c, @NotNull Coordinate coord, @Nullable TerminationCell.Type terminationType) {
        switch (c) {
            case 'W':
                return new Wall(coord);
            case '.':
                return new FillableCell(coord);
            case '^':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.UP, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case '>':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.RIGHT, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case '<':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.LEFT, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case 'v':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.DOWN, terminationType);
                }
                break;
        }

        return null;
    }
}
```

public void fillTiles(int distance) {
    if (distance < 0 || sourceCell == null) {
        return;
    }

    // Clear previous filled tiles and reset filled state on pipes
    for (Coordinate coord : filledTiles) {
        Cell cell = cells[coord.row][coord.col];
        if (cell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
            Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
            if (pipe != null) {
                pipe.setFilled(); // reset filled to false is not possible here, so we rely on fresh fill
            }
        } else if (cell instanceof TerminationCell terminationCell) {
            terminationCell.setFilled(); // reset filled to false is not possible here, so we rely on fresh fill
        }
    }
    filledTiles.clear();

    // BFS queue: each element is a pair of coordinate and current distance from source
    Queue<Map.Entry<Coordinate, Integer>> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
    Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceCell.coord;

    // Mark source cell as filled and add to queue
    sourceCell.setFilled();
    filledTiles.add(sourceCoord);
    queue.offer(Map.entry(sourceCoord, 0));

    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Map.Entry<Coordinate, Integer> entry = queue.poll();
        Coordinate current = entry.getKey();
        int currentDistance = entry.getValue();

        if (currentDistance >= distance) {
            continue; // reached max distance
        }

        Cell currentCell = cells[current.row][current.col];

        // Get possible directions to move from current cell
        Direction[] connections;

        if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell terminationCell) {
            // TerminationCell connects only in the direction it points to and opposite
            connections = new Direction[]{terminationCell.pointingTo.getOpposite(), terminationCell.pointingTo};
        } else if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
            Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
            if (pipe == null) {
                continue; // no pipe to fill or traverse
            }
            connections = pipe.getConnections();
        } else {
            // Wall or other cell types cannot be traversed
            continue;
        }

        // Mark current cell as filled
        if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
            Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
            if (pipe != null && !pipe.getFilled()) {
                pipe.setFilled();
                filledTiles.add(current);
            }
        } else if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell terminationCell) {
            terminationCell.setFilled();
            filledTiles.add(current);
        }

        // Explore neighbors connected by pipes
        for (Direction dir : connections) {
            Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(dir.getOffset());

            if (!isWithinBounds(neighborCoord)) {
                continue;
            }

            if (filledTiles.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                continue; // already filled
            }

            Cell neighborCell = cells[neighborCoord.row][neighborCoord.col];

            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell neighborFillable) {

                if (neighborPipe == null) {
                    continue; // no pipe to traverse
                }

                // Check if neighbor pipe connects back to current cell
                Direction oppositeDir = dir.getOpposite();
                Direction[] neighborConnections = neighborPipe.getConnections();
                boolean connectsBack = false;
                for (Direction ndir : neighborConnections) {
                    if (ndir == oppositeDir) {
                        connectsBack = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!connectsBack) {
                    continue; // no connection back, so no flow

                // Add neighbor to queue
                queue.offer(Map.entry(neighborCoord, currentDistance + 1));
            } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell neighborTerm) {
                // Check if neighbor termination cell connects back to current cell
                Direction oppositeDir = dir.getOpposite();
                if (neighborTerm.pointingTo == oppositeDir) {
                    // Add neighbor termination cell to queue
                    queue.offer(Map.entry(neighborCoord, currentDistance + 1));
                }
            }
        }

Response Text:---
The `checkPath` method should determine if there is a valid path from the `sourceCell` to the `sinkCell` by traversing through connected pipes and termination cells. A Breadth-First Search (BFS) is a good approach here. The BFS will start from the source cell, explore all reachable cells by following pipe connections, and check if the sink cell is reachable.

Key points for the implementation:
- Start BFS from the source cell coordinate.
- For each cell, get its connections (directions where the pipe or termination cell connects).
- For each connected direction, check the neighboring cell:
  - It must be within bounds.
  - It must have a pipe or be a termination cell.
  - The neighbor must connect back to the current cell (i.e., the neighbor's connections include the opposite direction).
- If the sink cell is reached, return true.
- If BFS finishes without reaching the sink, return false.

Here is a complete implementation of the `checkPath` method:

```java
public boolean checkPath() {
    if (sourceCell == null || sinkCell == null) {
        return false;
    }

    Set<Coordinate> visited = new HashSet<>();
    Queue<Coordinate> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
    queue.offer(sourceCell.coord);
    visited.add(sourceCell.coord);

    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        if (current.equals(sinkCell.coord)) {
            return true;
        }

        Cell currentCell = cells[current.row][current.col];
        Direction[] connections;

        if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell terminationCell) {
            // Termination cells connect in two directions: pointingTo and its opposite
            connections = new Direction[] { terminationCell.pointingTo.getOpposite(), terminationCell.pointingTo };
        } else if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
            Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
            if (pipe == null) {
                continue;
            }
            connections = pipe.getConnections();
        } else {
            continue; // Wall or other non-traversable cell
        }

        for (Direction dir : connections) {
            Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(dir.getOffset());
            if (!isWithinBounds(neighborCoord)) {
                continue;
            }
            if (visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                continue;
            }

            Cell neighborCell = cells[neighborCoord.row][neighborCoord.col];
            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell neighborFillable) {
                Pipe neighborPipe = neighborFillable.getPipe();
                if (neighborPipe == null) {
                    continue;
                }
                Direction oppositeDir = dir.getOpposite();
                Direction[] neighborConnections = neighborPipe.getConnections();
                boolean connectsBack = false;
                for (Direction ndir : neighborConnections) {
                    if (ndir == oppositeDir) {
                        connectsBack = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!connectsBack) {
                    continue;
                }
                queue.offer(neighborCoord);
                visited.add(neighborCoord);
            } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell neighborTerm) {
                // Sink or source cell must point back to current cell
                if (neighborTerm.pointingTo == dir.getOpposite()) {
                    queue.offer(neighborCoord);
                    visited.add(neighborCoord);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return false;
}
```

This method uses BFS to traverse the map starting from the source cell, following valid pipe connections, and returns true if the sink cell is reachable. Otherwise, it returns false.

      if (visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
        continue;
      }
      Cell neighborCell=cells[neighborCoord.row][neighborCoord.col];
      if (neighborCell instanceof       FillableCell neighborFillable) {
        Pipe neighborPipe=neighborFillable.getPipe();
        if (neighborPipe == null) {
          continue;
        }
        Direction oppositeDir=dir.getOpposite();
        Direction[] neighborConnections=neighborPipe.getConnections();
        boolean connectsBack=false;
        for (        Direction ndir : neighborConnections) {
          if (ndir == oppositeDir) {
            connectsBack=true;
            break;
          }
        }
        if (!connectsBack) {
          continue;
        }
        queue.offer(neighborCoord);
        visited.add(neighborCoord);
      }
 else       if (neighborCell instanceof       TerminationCell neighborTerm) {
        if (neighborTerm.pointingTo == dir.getOpposite()) {
          queue.offer(neighborCoord);
          visited.add(neighborCoord);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return false;
}

```java
	/**
	 * Constructs a map from a map string.

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

		printColumns.run();

		for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {

				System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(i);
			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3");
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
					cells[r][c] = new Wall(new Coordinate(r, c));
				} else {
					cells[r][c] = new FillableCell(new Coordinate(r, c));
				}
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceInfo.coord;
		Direction sourceDir = sourceInfo.dir;
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceCoord, sourceDir, TerminationCell.Type.SOURCE);
		cells[sourceCoord.row][sourceCoord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		Coordinate sinkCoord = sinkInfo.coord;
		Direction sinkDir = sinkInfo.dir;
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkCoord, sinkDir, TerminationCell.Type.SINK);
		cells[sinkCoord.row][sinkCoord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map size must be at least 3x3");
		}
		if (cells == null || cells.length != rows) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array row count mismatch");
		}
		for (Cell[] row : cells) {
			if (row == null || row.length != cols) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array column count mismatch");
			}
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		TerminationCell foundSource = null;
		TerminationCell foundSink = null;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = cells[r][c];
				if (cell == null) {
					throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at (" + r + "," + c + ") is null");
				}
				this.cells[r][c] = cell;
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell tc) {
					Coordinate coord = tc.coord;
					Direction dir = tc.pointingTo;
					boolean isEdge = (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1);
					if (tc.type == TerminationCell.Type.SOURCE) {
						if (isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Source cell must not be on edge at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
						}
						if (foundSource != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple source cells found");
						}
						Coordinate adjacent = coord.add(dir.getOffset());
						if (!isWithinBounds(adjacent)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Source cell points outside the map at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
						}
						Cell adjacentCell = cells[adjacent.row][adjacent.col];
						if (adjacentCell instanceof Wall) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Source cell points into a wall at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
						}
						foundSource = tc;
					} else if (tc.type == TerminationCell.Type.SINK) {
						if (!isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink cell must be on edge at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
						}
						if (foundSink != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple sink cells found");
						}
						Coordinate adjacent = coord.add(dir.getOffset());
						if (isWithinBounds(adjacent)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException(
									"Sink cell must point outside the map at (" + r + "," + c + ")");
						}
						foundSink = tc;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (foundSource == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No source cell found");
		}
		if (foundSink == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No sink cell found");
		}
		this.sourceCell = foundSource;
		this.sinkCell = foundSink;
	}

	boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
		int zeroBasedRow = row - 1;
		int zeroBasedCol = col - 1;
		if (zeroBasedRow < 0 || zeroBasedRow >= rows || zeroBasedCol < 0 || zeroBasedCol >= cols) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell cell = cells[zeroBasedRow][zeroBasedCol];
		if (cell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
			if (fillableCell.getPipe() == null) {
				fillableCell.setPipe(p);
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	/**
	 * Undoes a step from the map. <p> Effectively replaces the cell with an empty cell in the coordinate specified. </p>
	 * @param coord  Coordinate to reset.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException  if the cell is not an instance of  {@link FillableCell} .
	 */
	public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {
		if (!isWithinBounds(coord)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Coordinate out of map bounds: " + coord);
		}
		Cell cell = cells[coord.row][coord.col];
		if (!(cell instanceof FillableCell)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at " + coord + " is not a FillableCell");
		}
		cells[coord.row][coord.col] = new FillableCell(coord);
	}

	public void fillTiles(int distance) {
		if (distance < 0 || sourceCell == null) {
			return;
		}
		for (Coordinate coord : filledTiles) {
			Cell cell = cells[coord.row][coord.col];
			if (cell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
				Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
				if (pipe != null) {
					pipe.setFilled();
				}
			} else if (cell instanceof TerminationCell terminationCell) {
				terminationCell.setFilled();
			}
		}
		filledTiles.clear();
		Queue<Map.Entry<Coordinate, Integer>> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
		Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceCell.coord;
		sourceCell.setFilled();
		filledTiles.add(sourceCoord);
		queue.offer(Map.entry(sourceCoord, 0));
		while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
			Map.Entry<Coordinate, Integer> entry = queue.poll();
			Coordinate current = entry.getKey();
			int currentDistance = entry.getValue();
			if (currentDistance >= distance) {
				continue;
			}
			Cell currentCell = cells[current.row][current.col];
			Direction[] connections;
			if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell terminationCell) {
				connections = new Direction[] { terminationCell.pointingTo.getOpposite(), terminationCell.pointingTo };
			} else if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
				Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
				if (pipe == null) {
					continue;
				}
				connections = pipe.getConnections();
			} else {
				continue;
			}
			if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
				Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
				if (pipe != null && !pipe.getFilled()) {
					pipe.setFilled();
					filledTiles.add(current);
				}
			} else if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell terminationCell) {
				terminationCell.setFilled();
				filledTiles.add(current);
			}
			for (Direction dir : connections) {
				Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(dir.getOffset());
				if (!isWithinBounds(neighborCoord)) {
					continue;
				}
				if (filledTiles.contains(neighborCoord)) {
					continue;
				}
				Cell neighborCell = cells[neighborCoord.row][neighborCoord.col];
				if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell neighborFillable) {
					Pipe neighborPipe = neighborFillable.getPipe();
					if (neighborPipe == null) {
						continue;
					}
					Direction oppositeDir = dir.getOpposite();
					Direction[] neighborConnections = neighborPipe.getConnections();
					boolean connectsBack = false;
					for (Direction ndir : neighborConnections) {
						if (ndir == oppositeDir) {
							connectsBack = true;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (!connectsBack) {
						continue;
					}
					queue.offer(Map.entry(neighborCoord, currentDistance + 1));
				} else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell neighborTerm) {
					Direction oppositeDir = dir.getOpposite();
					if (neighborTerm.pointingTo == oppositeDir) {
						queue.offer(Map.entry(neighborCoord, currentDistance + 1));
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
```

```java
package game.pipes;

import game.MapElement;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Direction;
import util.PipePatterns;

public class Pipe implements MapElement {

    @NotNull
    private final Shape shape;
    private boolean filled = false;

    /**
     * Creates a new pipe with a given shape.
     *
     * @param shape Shape of the pipe.
     */
    public Pipe(@NotNull Shape shape) {
        this.shape = shape;
    }

    /**
     * Sets the pipe as filled.
     */
    public void setFilled() {
        filled = true;
    }

    /**
     * @return Whether this pipe is filled.
     */
    public boolean getFilled() {
        return filled;
    }

    /**
     * @return List of connections for this pipe.
     * @throws IllegalStateException if {@code this} pipe cannot be identified.
     */
    public @NotNull Direction[] getConnections() {
        switch (shape) {
            case HORIZONTAL:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.LEFT, Direction.RIGHT};
            case VERTICAL:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.UP, Direction.DOWN};
            case TOP_LEFT:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.UP, Direction.LEFT};
            case TOP_RIGHT:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.UP, Direction.RIGHT};
            case BOTTOM_LEFT:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.DOWN, Direction.LEFT};
            case BOTTOM_RIGHT:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.DOWN, Direction.RIGHT};
            case CROSS:
                return Direction.values();
            default:
                throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown shape");
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return The character representation of this pipe. Note that the representation is different for filled and
     * unfilled pipes.
     */
    @Override
    public char toSingleChar() {
        return shape.getCharByState(filled);
    }

    /**
     * Converts a String to a Pipe.
     *
     * <p>
     * Here is the list of ASCII representation to the pipes:
     * TL: Top-Left
     * TR: Top-Right
     * BL: Bottom-Left
     * BR: Bottom-Right
     * HZ: Horizontal
     * VT: Vertical
     * CR: Cross
     * </p>
     *
     * @param rep String representation of the pipe.
     * @return Pipe identified by the string.
     * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the String does not represent a known pipe.
     */
    public static @NotNull Pipe fromString(@NotNull String rep) {
        String actualRep = rep.trim();

        Pipe.Shape shape;
        switch (actualRep) {
            case "HZ":
                shape = Shape.HORIZONTAL;
                break;
            case "VT":
                shape = Shape.VERTICAL;
                break;
            case "TL":
                shape = Shape.TOP_LEFT;
                break;
            case "TR":
                shape = Shape.TOP_RIGHT;
                break;
            case "BL":
                shape = Shape.BOTTOM_LEFT;
                break;
            case "BR":
                shape = Shape.BOTTOM_RIGHT;
                break;
            case "CR":
                shape = Shape.CROSS;
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown shape");
        }

        return new Pipe(shape);
    }

    public enum Shape {
        HORIZONTAL(PipePatterns.Filled.HORIZONTAL, PipePatterns.Unfilled.HORIZONTAL),
        VERTICAL(PipePatterns.Filled.VERTICAL, PipePatterns.Unfilled.VERTICAL),
        TOP_LEFT(PipePatterns.Filled.TOP_LEFT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.TOP_LEFT),
        TOP_RIGHT(PipePatterns.Filled.TOP_RIGHT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.TOP_RIGHT),
        BOTTOM_LEFT(PipePatterns.Filled.BOTTOM_LEFT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.BOTTOM_LEFT),
        BOTTOM_RIGHT(PipePatterns.Filled.BOTTOM_RIGHT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.BOTTOM_RIGHT),
        CROSS(PipePatterns.Filled.CROSS, PipePatterns.Unfilled.CROSS);

        final char filledChar;
        final char unfilledChar;

        Shape(char filled, char unfilled) {
            this.filledChar = filled;
            this.unfilledChar = unfilled;
        }

        char getCharByState(boolean isFilled) {
            return isFilled ? filledChar : unfilledChar;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package util;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;

/**
 * Represents a direction in reference to a {@link game.map.cells.Cell}.
 */
public enum Direction {
    UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT;

    /**
     * @return The opposite direction of {@code this}.
     */
    @NotNull
    public Direction getOpposite() {
        switch (this) {
            case UP:
                return DOWN;
            case DOWN:
                return UP;
            case LEFT:
                return RIGHT;
            case RIGHT:
                return LEFT;
            default:
                throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown direction");
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return A unit coordinate offset as expressed by {@code this} coordinate.
     */
    @NotNull
    public Coordinate getOffset() {
        switch (this) {
            case UP:
                return new Coordinate(-1, 0);
            case DOWN:
                return new Coordinate(1, 0);
            case LEFT:
                return new Coordinate(0, -1);
            case RIGHT:
                return new Coordinate(0, 1);
            default:
                throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown direction");
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package game.map.cells;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Coordinate;
import util.Direction;
import util.PipePatterns;

/**
 * Represents a source or a sink {@link Cell}.
 */
public class TerminationCell extends Cell {

    private boolean isFilled = false;
    @NotNull
    public final Direction pointingTo;
    @NotNull
    public final Type type;

    public TerminationCell(Coordinate coord, @NotNull Direction d, @NotNull Type type) {
        super(coord);
        this.pointingTo = d;
        this.type = type;
    }

    /**
     * Sets this cell as filled.
     */
    public void setFilled() {
        isFilled = true;
    }

    @Override
    public char toSingleChar() {
        if (isFilled) {
            switch (pointingTo) {
                case UP:
                    return PipePatterns.Filled.UP_ARROW;
                case DOWN:
                    return PipePatterns.Filled.DOWN_ARROW;
                case LEFT:
                    return PipePatterns.Filled.LEFT_ARROW;
                case RIGHT:
                    return PipePatterns.Filled.RIGHT_ARROW;
            }
        } else {
            switch (pointingTo) {
                case UP:
                    return PipePatterns.Unfilled.UP_ARROW;
                case DOWN:
                    return PipePatterns.Unfilled.DOWN_ARROW;
                case LEFT:
                    return PipePatterns.Unfilled.LEFT_ARROW;
                case RIGHT:
                    return PipePatterns.Unfilled.RIGHT_ARROW;
            }
        }

        throw new IllegalStateException("Invalid pointingTo value!");
    }

    public enum Type {
        SOURCE, SINK
    }

    /**
     * Data class encapsulating the coordinate and direction of the {@link TerminationCell}.
     */
    public static class CreateInfo {

        public final Coordinate coord;
        public final Direction dir;

        public CreateInfo(@NotNull Coordinate coord, @NotNull Direction dir) {
            this.coord = coord;
            this.dir = dir;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package util;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Representation of a coordinate in {@link game.map.Map}.
 */
public class Coordinate {

    public final int row;
    public final int col;

    public Coordinate(int row, int col) {
        this.row = row;
        this.col = col;
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritDoc}
     */
    @Override
    public boolean equals(@Nullable Object obj) {
        if (obj == null) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!(obj instanceof Coordinate)) {
            return false;
        }

        return equals((Coordinate) obj);
    }

    public boolean equals(@NotNull Coordinate other) {
        return this.row == other.row && this.col == other.col;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hash(row, col);
    }

    /**
     * Adds {@code this} coordinate with another coordinate.
     *
     * @param other Other coordinate to add from.
     * @return New coordinate as a result of the addition.
     */
    @NotNull public Coordinate add(@NotNull Coordinate other) {
        return new Coordinate(this.row + other.row, this.col + other.col);
```

```java
package game.map.cells;

import game.MapElement;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;
import util.Direction;

/**
 * Representation of a cell in the {@link game.map.Map}.
 */
public abstract class Cell implements MapElement {

    @NotNull
    public final Coordinate coord;

    Cell(@NotNull Coordinate coord) {
        this.coord = coord;
    }

    /**
     * Parses a {@link Cell} from a character.
     *
     * <p>
     * Here is the list of characters to their corresponding map element:
     * W: Wall
     * .: Cell
     * ^: Source/Sink pipe pointing upward
     * v: Source/Sink pipe pointing downward
     * <: Source/Sink pipe pointing leftward
     * >: Source/Sink pipe pointing rightward
     * If the character does not represent a {@link TerminationCell}, the {@code terminationType} parameter can be ignored.
     * </p>
     *
     * @param c Character to parse.
     * @param coord Coordinate of the newly created cell.
     * @param terminationType If the character is a termination cell, its type. Otherwise, this argument is ignored and
     *                        can be null.
     * @return A cell based on the given creation parameters, or null if the parameters cannot form a valid Cell.
     */
    public static @Nullable Cell fromChar(char c, @NotNull Coordinate coord, @Nullable TerminationCell.Type terminationType) {
        switch (c) {
            case 'W':
                return new Wall(coord);
            case '.':
                return new FillableCell(coord);
            case '^':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.UP, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case '>':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.RIGHT, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case '<':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.LEFT, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case 'v':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.DOWN, terminationType);
                }
                break;
        }

        return null;
    }
}
```

        return false;

    Set<Coordinate> visited = new HashSet<>();
    Queue<Coordinate> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
    queue.offer(sourceCell.coord);
    visited.add(sourceCell.coord);

    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        if (current.equals(sinkCell.coord)) {
            return true;
        }

        Cell currentCell = cells[current.row][current.col];
        Direction[] connections;

        if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell terminationCell) {
            // Termination cells connect in two directions: pointingTo and its opposite
            connections = new Direction[] { terminationCell.pointingTo.getOpposite(), terminationCell.pointingTo };
        } else if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
            Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
            if (pipe == null) {
                continue;
            }
            connections = pipe.getConnections();
        } else {
            continue; // Wall or other non-traversable cell
        }

        for (Direction dir : connections) {
            Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(dir.getOffset());
            if (!isWithinBounds(neighborCoord)) {
                continue;
            }
            if (visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                continue;
            }

            Cell neighborCell = cells[neighborCoord.row][neighborCoord.col];
            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell neighborFillable) {
                Pipe neighborPipe = neighborFillable.getPipe();
                if (neighborPipe == null) {
                    continue;
                }
                Direction oppositeDir = dir.getOpposite();
                Direction[] neighborConnections = neighborPipe.getConnections();
                boolean connectsBack = false;
                for (Direction ndir : neighborConnections) {
                    if (ndir == oppositeDir) {
                        connectsBack = true;
                        break;

                }
                if (!connectsBack) {
                    continue;
                }
                queue.offer(neighborCoord);
                visited.add(neighborCoord);

                // Sink or source cell must point back to current cell
                if (neighborTerm.pointingTo == dir.getOpposite()) {
                    queue.offer(neighborCoord);
                    visited.add(neighborCoord);
                }
            }
        }
    }

The class `Map` tracks the currently filled tiles in the `filledTiles` set and the count of previously filled tiles in `prevFilledTiles`. If after a round the number of filled tiles has not increased, it means no new pipes were filled and the game is lost.

A correct implementation compares the current size of `filledTiles` with `prevFilledTiles`. If they are equal, return `true` (game lost). Otherwise, update `prevFilledTiles` to the current size and return `false`.

```java
	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(i);
			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}
```
